Posted by ABMN Staff on Oct 27th, 2018 // No Comments
Private Asset Management Inc. lessened its position in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2.1% during the second quarter, according to the company in its most recent 13F filing with the SEC. The fund owned 96,999 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 2,093 shares during the quarter. Apple makes up about 2.9% of Private Asset Management Inc.’s portfolio, making the stock its 7th biggest position. Private Asset Management Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $17,956,000 at the end of the most recent reporting period.
Other institutional investors have also recently made changes to their positions in the company. PrairieView Partners LLC increased its position in shares of Apple by 8.4% during the 2nd quarter. PrairieView Partners LLC now owns 11,380 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,107,000 after purchasing an additional 879 shares during the last quarter. BerganKDV Wealth Management LLC increased its position in shares of Apple by 30.2% during the 2nd quarter. BerganKDV Wealth Management LLC now owns 11,400 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,110,000 after purchasing an additional 2,644 shares during the last quarter. Delta Asset Management LLC TN increased its position in shares of Apple by 3.8% during the 2nd quarter. Delta Asset Management LLC TN now owns 9,434 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $1,746,000 after purchasing an additional 342 shares during the last quarter. Patriot Wealth Management Inc. increased its position in shares of Apple by 2.4% during the 2nd quarter. Patriot Wealth Management Inc. now owns 144,990 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $26,839,000 after purchasing an additional 3,373 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Cliftonlarsonallen Wealth Advisors LLC increased its position in shares of Apple by 27.7% during the 2nd quarter. Cliftonlarsonallen Wealth Advisors LLC now owns 17,862 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $3,306,000 after purchasing an additional 3,878 shares during the last quarter. 58.51% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors and hedge funds. Several research firms have weighed in on AAPL. BTIG Research raised Apple to a “buy” rating and boosted their price target for the stock from $207.00 to $235.00 in a research report on Wednesday, August 1st. Macquarie set a $214.00 price target on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research report on Wednesday, August 15th. Morgan Stanley reaffirmed a “buy” rating and set a $232.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, August 22nd. S&P Equity Research boosted their price target on Apple to $250.00 and gave the stock an “in-line” rating in a research report on Tuesday, September 11th. They noted that the move was a valuation call. Finally, UBS Group began coverage on Apple in a research report on Wednesday, September 12th. Three equities research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, eighteen have assigned a hold rating and thirty-one have assigned a buy rating to the company. The company currently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus price target of $224.63.
In related news, CEO Timothy D. Cook sold 265,160 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction on Monday, August 27th. The stock was sold at an average price of $217.79, for a total value of $57,749,196.40. The transaction was disclosed in a filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which can be accessed through the SEC website . Also, Director Arthur D. Levinson sold 20,000 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction on Thursday, August 2nd. The shares were sold at an average price of $206.58, for a total value of $4,131,600.00. Following the completion of the sale, the director now owns 1,153,283 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $238,245,202.14. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders sold a total of 564,185 shares of company stock valued at $124,444,213 over the last 90 days. 0.08% of the stock is currently owned by corporate insiders.
AAPL opened at $216.30 on Friday. The firm has a market capitalization of $1,080.35 billion, a P/E ratio of 23.49, a PEG ratio of 1.68 and a beta of 1.36. Apple Inc. has a 1 year low of $150.24 and a 1 year high of $233.47. The company has a quick ratio of 1.24, a current ratio of 1.31 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings results on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, beating the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $2.18 by $0.16. The business had revenue of $53.27 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $52.43 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 43.50% and a net margin of 21.98%. The firm’s quarterly revenue was up 17.3% on a year-over-year basis. During the same period in the previous year, the company posted $1.67 EPS. On average, research analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 11.77 EPS for the current fiscal year.
Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
